criteria.text: Replace selected artifact placeholder with viewer toolbar + WKWebView. Flutter fetches authenticated `/live-artifacts/:id/render` itself, then `loadHtmlString`; never load hosted URL in WebView, never inject bearer/cookies/storage paths. Viewer shows title/revision/date/provenance, Reload; loading/error/deleted/conflict isolated. Dashboard/sibling tabs unchanged.

JavaScript enabled; server CSP sandbox remains. NavigationDelegate blocks every top-level/non-initial navigation, popup, download, file/data/http(s) escape; no arbitrary external open in v1. Clear cookies/cache/localStorage around artifact/user transitions where API supports. No devtools, camera/mic/download/file access.

Closed bridge channel, maximum 64KiB JSON request, request ID bounded, exact methods only: `state.get`, `state.update`, `pco.services.read`. Reject malformed/unknown/duplicate/in-flight overflow. Native binds artifact ID/user/generation; stale/disposed/user-switched responses discarded. No URL/method/header/token/process/shell/file bridge.
criteria.evidence: Focused Flutter run: 17/17 pass. Boundary group proves ID/JSON/params/64KiB, exact state/PCO payloads, duplicate/8-inflight cleanup, reverse-order ID matching, and dispose/user/artifact lifecycle suppression. Initial run failed stale state mutation; the bridge now checks its existing isCurrent generation seam before publishing the update.

criteria.text: `state.get` returns current JSON + public revision; `state.update` calls hosted PUT state with exact expectedStateRevision and state only, propagates 409 current revision/410/404 safely; updates local revision on success. Shared/org users use AV02 permission. No bundle update from page.

`pco.services.read` calls exact AV05 endpoint with operation allowlist/body; current native user's auth only; returns projected external data. Never exposes OAuth/API bearer. Capability undeclared/disconnected/rate/permission failures safe.

Host response protocol is injection-safe: JSON encoding only, fixed non-configurable callback/bootstrap before artifact code; promise resolve/reject. Artifact cannot forge nonce/host success, overwrite callback, or make host run arbitrary JS. Backend render may inject minimal nonce-bearing `window.rhythm` bootstrap before stored artifact JS; if modifying render handler, add API shape/security tests and keep CSP/no-network/navigation. Stale route index: manual render blast radius only; new symbol unindexed.

State/script concurrency: one save at a time or revision-CAS; no out-of-order host responses; state payload 512KiB backend cap and bridge 64KiB request cap (document bridge lower cap). On reload, fresh authenticated render/state; visible update/reload behavior.

Tests: bridge parser/allowlist/size/injection/user-generation/stale/in-flight; data source auth + shapes/errors; widget states/reload; server bootstrap/CSP nonce order/smuggling; malicious artifact attempts network/top navigation/popup/file/localStorage/cookie/download/arbitrary bridge/response injection. Tests must be load-bearing.
criteria.evidence: Load-bearing mutation evidence recorded in 2026-08-09-av06-c3-c8-deterministic-bridge.md: removing duplicate, inflight, or stale guards makes its targeted contract fail.

criteria.text: Native packaged behavioral smoke on macOS with real sandbox API and WKWebView: create Worship Calendar HTML/JS, pin/open Dashboard tab, prove script renders, `state.get`, `state.update` revision 1→2, `pco.services.read` controlled fixture, blocked navigation/network/process; capture production-theme screenshot and logs. Use existing integration_test; no computer-control if native integration suffices. No production credentials.
Scope: no scheduler/background sync, arbitrary web/computer access, editing UI, Gallery migration, tab reorder/rename. This is capability-based only.

Fixture cleanup deletes only AV06-marked artifact collaborators, bundle/state revisions, artifacts, integration account/token, session, workspace membership, workspace, and user in FK-safe order; post-cleanup counts are zero on success or failure.

A DEBUG-only own-window capture records the production Dashboard artifact strip, toolbar, and rendered clean Worship Calendar without release registration, TCC, raw IDs, paths, credentials, hostile fixture chrome, or DEBUG chrome.

Accessible metadata exposes updatedByDisplayName, never raw updatedByUserId in Flutter UI, and the toolbar uses localized Updated date/by/revision formatting while safely omitting unavailable provenance.
Reload maps 404, 410, 409, forbidden, and generic failures to the same distinct tab states and recovery actions as initial load.

Explicit blocked navigation, forms, downloads, file input, and media permission attempts show one debounced nonblocking host message without accepting arbitrary bridge payloads or invoking APIs/host methods.
criteria.evidence: Native smoke records 4 accepted bootstrap notifications, 6 raw messages, 0 accepted unknown messages, one debounced snackbar, and zero unintended API/PCO calls; bridge unit tests cover valid and rejected payloads.
